observations: Photos show a car engine/engine assembly laid on the ground (not a complete car).
Engine bay components and wiring harness are visible; there is visible grime/road dust and some exposed metal surfaces.
There are multiple large hoses/cables and a prominent intake/cover area on top.
No clear readable model/part number plate is visible in the photos.
A watermark text appears on the images, but it is not a reliable identifier of the engine model.

claims.claim: We also deals in all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: Seller’s text only; photos show an engine assembly but do not confirm the business scope.

risks.risk: Exact engine make/model and compatibility are unknown from the photos, so the buyer may receive the wrong part for their vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification/label (engine code/serial plate) and the full VIN/vehicle details it came from (or a scan of the engine code).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown engine assembly with compatibility not guaranteed (worst case: buyer may need to verify and may not be able to use it).

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (could be seized, missing parts, or have internal damage).
risks.proof: Video of the engine running (cold start if possible) OR a compression test/leak-down test report, plus photos of all accessories and ports to confirm nothing is missing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: treated as non-working/for parts).

risks.risk: Missing components or incomplete assembly (some sensors, brackets, covers, or ancillary parts may be absent).
risks.proof: A complete parts inventory photo set: top, bottom, both sides, and close-ups of connectors/ports; plus a checklist of included items.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incomplete (worst case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

risks.risk: Transmission/gearbox mating or mounting compatibility is unclear (photos show an engine assembly; it may include or exclude key mating parts).
risks.proof: Photos showing the mating surface/adapter area and whether a gearbox is included; include part numbers for the adapter/gearbox if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine-only or uncertain mating (worst case: buyer must buy additional mating parts).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine code/serial plate (engine identification) and any part-number labels.
Video proof of operation (or compression/leak-down test results).
Photos of all sides plus close-ups of connectors/ports to confirm completeness (what is included/excluded).
Confirm whether any gearbox/adapter is included and show the mating area with part numbers.
response.reason: The photos show an engine assembly, but the exact make/model and working condition are not verifiable remotely, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without the key identification and proof of condition.
